name: Changes Filter
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      ci: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.ci }}
      security: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.security }}
      validation: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.validation }}
      dead-code: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.dead-code }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: changes
        with:
          filters: |
            ci:
              - 'src/**'
              - 'test/**'
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'tsconfig.json'
              - '.eslintrc.*'
              - '.prettierrc'
            security:
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'yarn.lock'
              - 'Dockerfile'
              - '.github/workflows/security.yml'
            validation:
              - 'content/**'
              - 'seo/**'
              - 'public/**'
              - '.github/workflows/validation.yml'
            dead-code:
              - 'src/**'
              - 'package.json'
              - 'tsconfig.json'

  ci:
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.ci == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci.yml

  security:
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.security == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/security.yml

  validation:
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.validation == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/validation.yml

  dead-code:
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.dead-code == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/dead-code-detection.yml
